extraction.name: TravelPlanner
extraction.description: A benchmark for real-world planning with language agents
extraction.creator: Jian Xie, Kai Zhang, Jiangjie Chen, Tinghui Zhu, Renze Lou, Yuandong Tian, Yanghua Xiao, Yu Su
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is constructed from a variety of sources including Kaggle Flight Status Prediction, Google Distance Matrix API, Kaggle Zomato Restaurants Dataset, Google Places API, and Kaggle Airbnb Open Data Dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Web API, Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Around four million data entries crawled from the Internet
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human annotators meticulously curated 1,225 query-plan pairs
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: 20 graduate students annotated plans for synthesized queries
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: TravelPlanner aims to provide an effective benchmark for complex planning in future research
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current agents still struggle with complex planning tasks that humans are capable of
